_comment: 20 works, hand-written synopses (not copied from TMDB/Open Library). Vectors are NOT stored here: tests/fixtures/catalog.py generates them from `clusters` + `axes`. Cluster layout: haunted, cozy, epic and literary each hold 2 movies + 2 books. 'adventure' (movies only) sits near 'scifi' (books only) so cross-media neighbours are predictable. The Jurassic Park pair is an adaptation whose two halves sit in DIFFERENT clusters (link-only candidates). The Hobbit pair is deliberately NOT linked (Wikidata covers only about a third of adaptations).

works.title: The Shining
works.synopsis: A struggling writer takes a winter caretaker job at a huge, isolated mountain hotel with his wife and young son. As snow closes the roads, the hotel's strange history seems to take hold of him.

card.logline: A family stranded in a vast empty building over a snowbound winter finds that its past is pressing in on the father.
card.setting: a remote mountain lodge, deep winter

works.title: The Haunting
works.synopsis: A doctor invites several guests with unusual pasts to stay in a notorious old mansion to study supernatural activity. The shy, lonely woman among them begins to feel the house is calling to her.

card.logline: A lonely woman drawn into a notorious old house starts to feel it wants her to stay.
card.setting: an isolated mansion, mid-20th-century

works.title: Knives Out
works.synopsis: When a wealthy mystery writer dies after his birthday party, a polite private detective questions his quarrelsome family. The patriarch's devoted nurse becomes the unlikely key to the case.

card.logline: A genteel investigator untangles a feuding family's secrets after their patriarch's sudden death.
card.setting: a sprawling country mansion, present day

works.title: Murder on the Orient Express
works.synopsis: A famous detective is stranded on a snowbound luxury train when a wealthy passenger is found stabbed. Every traveler in the carriage has something to hide.

card.logline: A meticulous detective must find the killer among a carriage of elegant strangers trapped by snow.
card.setting: a luxury train stranded in snow, 1930s Europe

works.title: The Fellowship of the Ring
works.synopsis: A humble young man inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out with eight companions to destroy it before a dark lord can reclaim it.

card.logline: An unassuming young traveler and a band of allies set out to destroy a corrupting treasure before an ancient evil finds it.
card.setting: a vast fantasy realm of green countryside, forests and mountains

works.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
works.synopsis: A comfort-loving homebody is swept into a company of dwarves journeying to reclaim their lost mountain home from a dragon.

card.logline: A reluctant homebody joins a band of exiles on a long journey to win back their lost homeland.
card.setting: a vast fantasy realm of rolling hills, caves and mountains

works.title: Manchester by the Sea
works.synopsis: After his brother dies, a withdrawn handyman returns to his hometown to become guardian of his teenage nephew and must face the tragedy that drove him away.

card.logline: A man shattered by loss is pulled back to his hometown to care for a grieving teenager.
card.setting: a small New England fishing town, present day

works.title: The Remains of the Day
works.synopsis: A devoted English butler, proud of his perfect service, takes a road trip to visit a former housekeeper and slowly confronts the love and principles he sacrificed to his employer.

card.logline: A dutiful servant looks back on a lifetime of loyalty and the love he never allowed himself.
card.setting: an English country estate, 1930s with a 1950s frame
